root_idea.summary: The root centers on preventing access, passage, or contact by blocking or intervening.
root_idea.development: From the basic notion of prevention, the lexicon develops meanings for barriers and coverings, then extends by resemblance to the diaphragm, eyebrow, projecting edges, the sun's boundary, and persons who guard an entrance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: A distinct Quran-attested noun with several explicitly supported barrier, veil, and horizon uses.
A distinct Quran-attested passive participle, normalized from the supplied plural occurrence to its singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: An intervening barrier or partition that prevents access, passage, or mutual reach; a physical or abstract separation.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, this can separate distinct parties or domains without necessarily meaning a covering that blocks vision. In 7:46 it prevents the enjoyment of one realm from reaching the other and harm from passing between them.

senses.definition: A veil, screen, or covering that conceals a person or thing from view.
senses.usage_conditions: It may be a physical screen or veil, including a separating screen behind which communication occurs without visual access.

senses.definition: The horizon or setting boundary behind which the sun disappears.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-specific use in the expression describing the sun's disappearance at sunset, in 38:32.

senses.definition: One kept from access or benefit; in the Quranic context, one shut off from the light associated with his Lord.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle. In 83:15 the exclusion is understood as deprivation from the divine light or access, rather than merely being physically veiled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prevent, hinder, debar, or preclude someone or something, especially from entering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verbal use, including exclusion from an intended place or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To veil, conceal, hide, cover, or protect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verbal use applied to persons or things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To intervene or stand between two things or bodies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an intervening entity or partition, including bodily structures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To serve as a حاجب for a ruler, governor, or commander.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction referring to service as a door-keeper or chamberlain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become prevented or debarred, or to withdraw and become secluded, veiled, or concealed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII use may describe withdrawal from people or concealment of a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a pregnant woman, to enter the period associated with a day of the ninth month.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic usage referring to seclusion after a day of the ninth month has passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint someone to the office of حاجب, a door-keeper or chamberlain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative or appointing use with a person as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The windpipe or passage of the breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill, especially a lofty hill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The projecting head, crest, or upper edge of the hip or haunch bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term, also used of corresponding projecting parts in a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written charm or amulet worn in a case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or specialized usage marked as assumed figurative in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The diaphragm or midriff, the intervening structure between the heart and the remainder of the body cavity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical specialization, also associated with the septum or covering of the heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain or elevated part of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative topographical extension based on its intervening or terminating position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where a stony tract ends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized topographical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long, uniformly continuous tract of sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized topographical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The light, tract, or side of the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized usage referring to a portion or aspect of the sun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office of a door-keeper or chamberlain, including guardianship of the Kaaba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational or institutional noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A door-keeper, chamberlain, or guardian at an entrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The title is associated with preventing people from entering and can include guardians of the Kaaba.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eyebrow, or either of the bones above the eyes with the hair and flesh upon them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, understood as protecting or screening the eyes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The piece of wood over the lintel of a door-frame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative architectural extension of the eyebrow or upper barrier.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The edge, side, or upper limb of the disk of the sun or moon as it begins to appear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative astronomical usage modeled on the eyebrow or upper edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The edge or side of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the notion of an upper or screening edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The beginning or first appearance of dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural usage for the emerging beginnings of morning light.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Secluded, concealed, or veiled from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use describing a king secluded from people or a person concealed by a covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative usage marked as assumed tropical in the lexical evidence.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Becoming prevented, secluded, veiled, or concealed.
Barrier, intervening partition, veil, and concealment branches are covered by the Quranic حِجَاب senses.
Light, tract, or side of the sun.
Kaaba guardianship is included in the institutional office meaning.
Eyebrow or bones above the eyes.
Upper edge of the sun or moon.
Edge or side of a thing.
Quranic debarment and broader secluded or veiled uses are separately represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the preceding participial entry.

cautions: The horizon sense belongs specifically to the Quranic sunset expression and should not be generalized to every occurrence of حِجَاب.

The Quranic English renderings vary between barrier, partition, screen, and veil; these reflect overlapping contextual realizations of the barrier and concealment senses rather than separate senses for every translation.
